snippet.title: Barbie Horse Trails | Announcement Trailer | UK | PEGI
snippet.description:
Saddle up for adventure in Barbie Horse Trails! 🎮🐴 
Join Barbie & Barbie on a cozy open-world journey through Canterbury Trails Park. 
Ride with your horse, Lucky, and complete quests to become a junior ranger! 
Discover hidden trails, spot amazing wildlife, and explore the beauty of the park. 🌿✨
Barbie Horse Trails launches on all platforms on October 10th! 🎮💖 
#BarbieHorseTrails #barbie 

Discover more: https://outrightgames.com/games/barbie-horse-trails/
